newer_changes_search: Web search (2026-10-26) for 2025-2026 JSY revisions (PIB, MoHFW, NHM): none found. Amounts reported in 2026 match the NHM page (LPS Rs 1,400 rural / Rs 1,000 urban; HPS Rs 700 / Rs 600). The NHM page is undated, but nothing newer replaces it.

findings.note: The LPS list follows the NHM page (which names 'Jammu and Kashmir', from before 2019). Ladakh ('la') was part of J&K when the list was made, but is not in the rule, so a general-category, non-BPL woman in Ladakh gets 'not eligible'.
findings.suggestion: Check the current NHM treatment of Ladakh. If it is still an LPS area, add 'la', or set the rule to 'uncertain' for Ladakh.

findings.note: The field is 'pregnant or breastfeeding'. JSY pays for an institutional delivery, so a breastfeeding mother whose delivery is over (or happened at home) passes the rule although the benefit may no longer apply.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable with the current field set. Make the how_to_apply wording clear that the payment is tied to the delivery.

findings.note: 'The money goes to your bank account', and the mcp_card and bank_account documents, are not in the NHM snapshot (it gives eligibility and amounts only).
findings.suggestion: Snapshot the JSY guidelines PDF linked from the NHM page and cite it for payment mode and documents, or drop these claims.

findings.note: 'every woman delivering in a government facility qualifies' is a firm statement. It mirrors the source table ('All pregnant women delivering in government health centres') and is third person, but it reads close to a promise.
findings.suggestion: Prefer 'the scheme covers all women who deliver in a government facility'.
